description: Identify geo.admin features at a WGS84 point on one ech MapServer layer. Use search_map_layers to find the layer id. Historical time-series layers keep only the current feature unless include_historical is true.

include_historical.description: Keep historical versions when a layer has an is_current_jahr attribute (default false).

lang.description: Label language: en (default), de, fr, it, or rm.

tolerance.description: Search tolerance in pixels (default 5, max 50). Use a higher value for lines and points.

name: identify_map_layer
